entries: Added a `Configure MCP servers...` row for installed plugins in `/plugin`, so you can set or change a plugin's MCP server variables at any time without disabling and re-enabling it; plugins with missing values show `⚠ needs setup`, each server shows `✓ configured` or the variables it still needs, and saving restarts an enabled plugin's servers so the new values take effect.

Improved terminal sandbox defaults to protect more credentials: sandboxed commands can no longer read or modify `~/.docker`, `~/.kube`, or `~/_netrc` unless you grant access explicitly. Previously `~/.docker` and `~/.kube` were writable inside the sandbox, so sandboxed commands that use Docker registry or Kubernetes cluster credentials now need an explicit grant.
Improved context compaction, including `/compact`, to keep images, PDFs, and other files you attached in the conversation summary, so the agent can still see them after older history is summarized.

Improved permission prompts so that allowing an action for the conversation, in the main agent or in a subagent, applies across the main conversation and all of its subagents instead of asking again for the same action.

Improved the in-progress status line to show what the agent is waiting on, such as initializing MCP servers or retrying an unavailable model (for example `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s` with a live countdown), instead of a generic working label.
Improved `/diff` to highlight the exact words that changed within each modified line, in every color scheme.

Improved `agy plugin validate`: it now has `--help`, checks a plugin's context providers (missing `label` or `command`, invalid or duplicate triggers, unknown fields, missing command files), warns about `skills` entries in `plugin.json` that don't exist or contain no `SKILL.md`, and reports every `SKILL.md` the plugin loader skips, including skills listed through `plugin.json` or `skills.json`.
Fixed terminal commands occasionally failing to start with `argument list too long` when the model returned a very large reasoning signature with the tool call.

Fixed text cursors drifting away from the insertion point after wide characters (CJK, emoji), tabs, other Unicode spaces, and on soft-wrapped lines, including `Up`/`Down` landing on the wrong row, in the prompt and in the settings, permission amend, plugin setup, feedback, hooks, and artifact search boxes.
Fixed the `Esc disabled during file edits` warning naming the wrong reject key when the prompt shows an extra choice, such as for edits outside the workspace in accept-edits mode.
Fixed sign-in not persisting across restarts on macOS and Windows for enterprise accounts, because the saved credential exceeded the system keychain's size limit.

Improved how agent responses read: a blank line now separates the collapsed thought block from the response, and once the response starts, the collapsed thought shows only its `Thought for …` header instead of repeating a snippet of the thinking; expand it to see the full thinking.

Improved `/` search in the `/diff` file view to count matches inside folded unchanged lines, such as `match 2/5 · +3 hidden` or `no matches · +1 hidden`, and the `f` hint now reads `show N hidden matches`.

Improved `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` to mark the selected commit with the same `>` cursor and selection color as `All Changes` and `Per Turn` instead of a highlighted bar, and made `Per Turn` start with the cursor on the first file instead of its turn header.

Improved recurring cron schedules created with the agent's `schedule` tool to fire at a consistent per-schedule offset instead of exactly on the cron boundary, to avoid traffic spikes: schedules that repeat within a day, such as every 30 minutes or hourly, now fire somewhere within their period, fixed-time schedules such as daily at 9:00 still fire within their scheduled minute, and the agent can request exact timing when a schedule needs it. `@every` schedules are unchanged.
Improved idle CPU usage by pausing screen refreshes while nothing on screen changes, roughly halving the CLI's CPU use when it is idle.
Improved CPU usage while a response streams by skipping redundant screen updates and refreshing the credit balance less often.
Improved rendering speed for long conversations, and made long conversations load faster when you resume them.
Improved startup CPU usage when the CLI refreshes its conversation summaries.
Improved memory usage by allocating storage for the prompt and other text inputs as you type instead of reserving it up front.
Fixed the agent silently retrying, potentially without end, when a model response was blocked by content safety filters.
Fixed plugins failing to load when `plugin.json` gives `skills` as a single path string, such as `"skills": "./skills/"`, instead of an array, as some plugins written for other tools do.
Fixed marketplace plugin installs and automatic updates failing with a checksum mismatch or network error when a download was briefly stale or interrupted; the CLI now retries the download once.

title.zh-TW: 回覆正文與收合思考區塊空行區隔，頂端僅保留標題
title.en: Blank line separates response text from collapsed thought block, leaving only the header at the top

body.zh-TW: 閱讀代理人剛生成的回覆時，若思考過程與正文擠成一團，往往會打斷閱讀節奏。⟦像在會議中翻閱專案報告，以前草稿筆記直接黏在結論上方容易分散焦點；現在頂端只留一張寫著構思時間的簡潔書籤，中間隔出一行空白，正文一目了然，需要時再翻開整份草稿。⟧現在代理人開始輸出回覆後，收合的思考區塊只會顯示 `Thought for …` 標題，不再重複列出思考過程的文字片段。收合的思考區塊與正文之間也多了一行空行隔開，文字段落不會再擠在一起。如果你想確認剛才完整的推導邏輯，只要手動展開該區塊，依然能查閱完整的思考內容。
body.en: When reading a newly generated response from an agent, having the thought process clustered against the main text often breaks your reading flow. ⟦Picture reviewing a project report during a meeting: previously, draft notes stuck directly above the conclusion would distract focus, whereas now only a neat bookmark noting thinking time remains at the top with a blank line in between, keeping the main text clear at a glance while letting you unfold the full draft whenever needed.⟧ Now, once the agent begins outputting a response, the collapsed thought block only displays the `Thought for …` header instead of repeating text snippets from the thought process. A blank line also separates the collapsed thought block from the main text, so text paragraphs no longer bunch together. If you want to verify the complete reasoning logic behind it, you can still view the full thoughts simply by expanding the block manually.

items.original: Improved how agent responses read: a blank line now separates the collapsed thought block from the response, and once the response starts, the collapsed thought shows only its `Thought for …` header instead of repeating a snippet of the thinking; expand it to see the full thinking.

title.zh-TW: 比對檢視支援折疊搜尋計數，游標樣式與停駐位置對齊
title.en: Diff view supports folded search counts, aligning cursor style and resting position

body.zh-TW: 檢閱程式碼變更時，折疊起來的未更動行數常讓搜尋結果變得難以掌握。⟦好比翻閱厚重的帳冊索引，以前夾在折頁裡的項目算不進筆數，各分冊的標記色塊也不一致；現在標籤直接註記折疊處藏有幾筆帳目，選取欄位也統一換成箭頭符號，翻到當前回合就直接對準第一筆明細。⟧在 `/diff` 檔案檢視中以 `/` 搜尋時，工具現在會計算折疊行內的相符項目，以 `match 2/5 · +3 hidden` 顯示隱藏數量，`f` 鍵展開提示也改為 `show N hidden matches`。介面上，`Commit Tree` 改用與 `All Changes` 及 `Per Turn` 相同的 `>` 游標與選取色，不再用高亮色塊；切換到 `Per Turn` 時游標也會直接停在第一個檔案，不必再跳過回合標題。
body.en: When reviewing code changes, collapsed unchanged lines often make search results hard to track. ⟦Much like browsing a thick ledger index, items tucked inside folded pages were previously excluded from match counts and marker color blocks across volumes were inconsistent, whereas tabs now directly annotate how many entries are hidden in folds, selection columns uniformly switch to arrow symbols, and turning to the current turn lands straight on the first detail.⟧ When searching with `/` inside the `/diff` file view, the tool now counts matches within folded lines, displaying the hidden count as `match 2/5 · +3 hidden`, and the `f` key expand hint is now updated to `show N hidden matches`. On the interface, `Commit Tree` now uses the same `>` cursor and selection color as `All Changes` and `Per Turn` instead of highlight blocks; when switching to `Per Turn`, the cursor also rests directly on the first file without needing to skip past turn headers.

items.original:
Improved `/` search in the `/diff` file view to count matches inside folded unchanged lines, such as `match 2/5 · +3 hidden` or `no matches · +1 hidden`, and the `f` hint now reads `show N hidden matches`.
Improved `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` to mark the selected commit with the same `>` cursor and selection color as `All Changes` and `Per Turn` instead of a highlighted bar, and made `Per Turn` start with the cursor on the first file instead of its turn header.

title.zh-TW: 循環排程引入偏移時間差，避免整點邊界流量暴增
title.en: Recurring schedules introduce time offsets to prevent traffic spikes on hour boundaries

body.zh-TW: 若有多個背景任務排在整點同時啟動，瞬間湧入的連線很容易讓伺服器塞車。⟦跟社區大樓安排住戶分流一樣，以前所有單位全擠在整點出門容易在閘門大塞車；現在為每個單位分配固定的前後時間差，整點前後平順出發，需要分秒不差的專車依然能申請在準點出發。⟧由代理人透過 `schedule` 工具建立的循環 cron 排程，現在觸發時會依每個排程套用固定的偏移時間，不再剛好卡在整點邊界，有效分散尖峰流量。在一天內多次重複的任務（例如每 30 分鐘或每小時一次），會在各自週期內的特定時間點觸發。每天早上 9:00 等固定時間排程，依然會在預定的該分鐘內執行。若排程需要嚴格對準時刻，代理人也能要求精確時間，而 `@every` 間隔排程則維持原樣不變。
body.en: When multiple background tasks are scheduled to launch at the same time on the hour, an instant surge of connections easily congests the server. ⟦Just as a residential complex staggers departures for its tenants, having every household head out right on the hour previously caused massive gate congestion, but assigning a fixed offset window to each unit now smooths out traffic around the hour while reserved shuttles that require exact timing can still request sharp departure times.⟧ Recurring cron schedules created by an agent via the `schedule` tool now apply a fixed offset time to each schedule when triggered, no longer landing exactly on hour boundaries and effectively spreading out peak traffic. Tasks that repeat multiple times throughout the day (such as every 30 minutes or once an hour) trigger at specific points within their respective intervals. Fixed-time schedules like 9:00 AM every morning still execute within their scheduled minute. If a schedule requires strict time alignment, the agent can also request exact timing, while `@every` interval schedules remain unchanged.

items.original: Improved recurring cron schedules created with the agent's `schedule` tool to fire at a consistent per-schedule offset instead of exactly on the cron boundary, to avoid traffic spikes: schedules that repeat within a day, such as every 30 minutes or hourly, now fire somewhere within their period, fixed-time schedules such as daily at 9:00 still fire within their scheduled minute, and the agent can request exact timing when a schedule needs it. `@every` schedules are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 降低閒置與執行資源消耗，長對話與啟動載入更流暢
title.en: Reduced idle and runtime resource consumption with smoother long conversations and startup loading

body.zh-TW:
長時間在終端機開啟工具或處理大型專案時，背景消耗的硬體資源現在明顯下降。

當畫面沒有任何文字變動時，終端機會暫停螢幕重繪，讓閒置時的 CPU 使用率約減少一半。而在模型輸出串流回覆的過程中，工具會略過重複的畫面更新，並降低額度餘額的刷新頻率以節省運算效能。

長篇對話的渲染效能有所改善，重新恢復長對話工作階段時的載入速度也提升。命令列介面啟動並刷新對話摘要時，CPU 開銷也一併降低。

在記憶體管理方面，輸入提示詞與各類文字時改為打字時才動態配置儲存空間，不再預先保留整塊記憶體。閒置時的 CPU 消耗降低，長對話顯示與恢復載入也更快。
body.en:
When keeping the tool open in the terminal for long periods or working on large projects, background hardware resource consumption has now noticeably decreased.

When there are no text changes on screen, the terminal pauses screen repaints, cutting idle CPU usage roughly in half. Meanwhile, while the model streams output, the tool skips redundant screen redraws and lowers the refresh frequency of quota balances to save computing power.

Rendering performance for long conversations has improved, and loading speed when resuming long conversation sessions has also increased. When the command-line interface launches and refreshes conversation summaries, CPU overhead is similarly reduced.

Regarding memory management, storage space for prompt inputs and various texts is now dynamically allocated during typing instead of pre-allocating entire memory blocks. Idle CPU consumption drops, and long conversation display as well as resumption loading become faster.

items.original:
Improved idle CPU usage by pausing screen refreshes while nothing on screen changes, roughly halving the CLI's CPU use when it is idle.
Improved CPU usage while a response streams by skipping redundant screen updates and refreshing the credit balance less often.
Improved rendering speed for long conversations, and made long conversations load faster when you resume them.
Improved startup CPU usage when the CLI refreshes its conversation summaries.
Improved memory usage by allocating storage for the prompt and other text inputs as you type instead of reserving it up front.

title.zh-TW: 模型遭安全機制阻擋時停止無止盡重試
title.en: Stop infinite retries when the model is blocked by safety mechanisms

body.zh-TW: 遇上模型回覆被內容安全過濾機制阻擋的突發狀況，代理人過去容易陷入停不下來的重試迴圈。以前遇到回應被安全過濾器阻擋時，代理人會在背景靜默重試，甚至可能陷入無止盡的重試迴圈；現在這個問題已經修好，遇到阻擋時不再默默持續重試。
body.en: When encountering unexpected situations where a model response was blocked by content safety filters, agents previously tended to get trapped in an endless retry loop. In the past, when a response was blocked by safety filters, the agent would silently retry in the background and could even enter an infinite retry loop; this issue has now been resolved, and it no longer keeps silently retrying when blocked.

items.original: Fixed the agent silently retrying, potentially without end, when a model response was blocked by content safety filters.

title.zh-TW: 外掛設定支援以字串指定技能路徑，避免載入失敗
title.en: Plugin configuration supports specifying skill paths as strings to prevent loading failures

body.zh-TW: 想載入為其他工具設計的外掛程式時，設定檔格式只要稍有不同就會直接報錯。以前如果外掛的 `plugin.json` 將 `skills` 欄位寫成單一路徑字串（例如 `"skills": "./skills/"`）而非陣列清單，外掛就會載入失敗。現在這個問題已經修好，工具能正確辨識單一路徑字串並完成載入。
body.en: When trying to load plugins designed for other tools, any slight difference in configuration format would directly trigger an error. Previously, if a plugin's `plugin.json` specified the `skills` field as a single path string (such as `"skills": "./skills/"`) instead of an array list, the plugin failed to load. This issue has now been resolved, and the tool correctly recognizes a single path string and completes loading.

items.original: Fixed plugins failing to load when `plugin.json` gives `skills` as a single path string, such as `"skills": "./skills/"`, instead of an array, as some plugins written for other tools do.

title.zh-TW: 市集外掛安裝與更新遇網路中斷自動重試一次
title.en: Marketplace plugin installation and updates automatically retry once on network interruption

body.zh-TW: 從市集安裝或自動更新外掛程式時，偶發的網路震盪容易造成程序中斷。以前下載內容短暫過時或下載中斷時，市集外掛安裝與自動更新可能因校驗碼不符或網路錯誤而失敗；現在命令列介面會自動重試下載一次。
body.en: When installing or automatically updating plugins from the marketplace, occasional network disruptions easily interrupted the process. Previously, when downloaded content was temporarily stale or downloads were interrupted, marketplace plugin installations and automatic updates could fail due to checksum mismatches or network errors; the command-line interface now automatically retries the download once.

items.original: Fixed marketplace plugin installs and automatic updates failing with a checksum mismatch or network error when a download was briefly stale or interrupted; the CLI now retries the download once.

entries: Added Auto mode on Windows 11 version 24H2 and later for personal Google Accounts, selectable via `--mode auto`, `Agent Mode` in `/config`, `Shift+Tab`, or Remote Control Settings (`Agent` remains the default).

Added whole-file toggle (`f`) and hunk folding (`Ctrl+O`) to `Commit Tree` and `Per Turn` views in `/diff`, and consolidated `Per Turn` diffs so multiple edits to a file in one turn appear as a single combined diff.
Added `_meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"]` to MCP `tools/call` requests so MCP servers receive the top-level conversation ID even when a tool is called from a nested subagent.

Improved Auto mode's review of commands that leave the terminal sandbox to include the assistant's preceding question on short replies like `yes`, check every subcommand in pipelines, and prompt before destructive Git or file commands.

Improved `agy plugin validate` with stricter checks across `plugin.json`, MCP server configs, `hooks.json`, and sidecar manifests for invalid JSON syntax, unknown fields, bad variable placeholders, unrecognized hook tool matchers, and missing hook scripts.
Improved CPU and memory usage while streaming responses by caching streamed code-block syntax tokens, rendered Markdown blocks, and inline file-edit confirmation diffs across frames.
Improved `/compact` and automatic compaction to retain tool declarations on summarization requests so the model API reuses its cached prompt prefix.
Improved Remote Control on tablets and foldables to use the multi-pane layout with touch-sized controls instead of collapsing to the phone view, and kept popovers open while dragging scrollbars.

Fixed subagents losing plugins inherited from the parent session, and fixed plugin-bundled subagents with `plugins.inherit_user: false` and restricted MCP tools failing to start with `mcp spec not found for provider`.
Fixed rules and `SKILL.md` skills loading twice when discovered from both a standalone customization folder and an enabled plugin.
Fixed long rows wrapping instead of truncating at the terminal width in `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` and `Per Turn` lists, and `Per Turn` headers truncating prompts at 50 characters.
Fixed the prompt box staying mid-screen after closing panels, dropdowns, or inline prompts, and blank gaps appearing above the prompt in `Medium` verbosity mode.
Fixed `Ctrl+Z` undo in the prompt mishandling pasted text, merging typing with recalled history entries, recording no-op `Backspace` or `Delete` steps, and truncating characters near emoji.
Fixed MCP client sessions and background connection routines leaking when `tools/list` failed during server startup or when the CLI shut down while a server was connecting.
Fixed the system prompt's user rules wording so `GEMINI.md` and `AGENTS.md` rules explicitly override earlier built-in instructions instead of only instructions that follow them.
Fixed supported media attachments with parameterized MIME types such as `audio/webm; codecs=opus` being rejected as unsupported.

Fixed several UI issues in Remote Control, including clipped headers and dialogs on phones, iOS Safari zoom on input focus, `Enable Telemetry` and `Marketing Emails` reverting while Settings loads, and dragged URLs losing query or `#` parameters.

Fixed rendering and export bugs in Remote Control, including broken nested code blocks, `$VAR` shell variables parsed as LaTeX, broken media previews, blurry or blank diagrams in `Copy Image` and `Export as PDF`, and background-tab timer drift.

title.zh-TW: Auto 模式登陸 Windows 11，加強沙盒外高風險指令審查
title.en: Auto Mode Arrives on Windows 11 with Stricter Out-of-Sandbox Command Review

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 11 24H2 或更新版本上使用個人 Google 帳戶時，現在你可以體驗能自行決定工具呼叫的 Auto 模式。⟦如同具備主動防護的車輛巡航系統，以前只照既定速限行駛而難以應對突發變換，現在遇到危險路況會主動放慢並要求駕駛接手確認。⟧你可以透過 `--mode auto` 參數、在 `/config` 設定選單的 Agent Mode 選取、按下快捷鍵 `Shift+Tab`，或是開啟 Remote Control 設定進行切換，預設選項仍維持為 Agent 模式。當 Auto 模式審查即將脫離終端機沙盒（sandbox，隔離指令執行的安全環境）的指令時，防護更為嚴謹。面對管線指令會逐一檢查其中的每個子指令；若是 `yes` 等簡短回覆，會連同助理的前一個提問一併納入評估，並在執行具破壞性的 Git 或檔案操作前主動跳出提示確認。
body.en: When running on Windows 11 24H2 or later with a personal Google account, you can now experience Auto mode, which decides tool calls on its own. ⟦Picture a car cruise control system with active safety: where it once only held a preset speed and struggled with sudden shifts, it now slows down on hazardous roads and prompts the driver to take over.⟧ You can switch modes via the `--mode auto` flag, by selecting Agent Mode in the `/config` settings menu, by pressing `Shift+Tab`, or by enabling Remote Control settings, while Agent mode remains the default. When Auto mode reviews commands about to leave the terminal sandbox (an isolated security environment for command execution), safeguards are significantly stricter. For pipeline commands, it inspects every sub-command individually; for short replies like `yes`, it evaluates them alongside the assistant's preceding question, prompting for confirmation before running destructive Git or file operations.

items.original:
Added Auto mode on Windows 11 version 24H2 and later for personal Google Accounts, selectable via `--mode auto`, `Agent Mode` in `/config`, `Shift+Tab`, or Remote Control Settings (`Agent` remains the default).
Improved Auto mode's review of commands that leave the terminal sandbox to include the assistant's preceding question on short replies like `yes`, check every subcommand in pipelines, and prompt before destructive Git or file commands.

title.zh-TW: /diff 支援區塊折疊與整檔切換，修正清單換行與標題截斷
title.en: /diff Adds Hunk Folding and Full File Toggle, Fixing List Wrapping and Title Truncation

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入 `/diff` 檢視程式碼變更時，Commit Tree 與 Per Turn 兩種檢視模式新增了多項閱讀控制。⟦跟查閱裝訂成冊的工程藍圖一樣，以前只能整頁攤開翻找細節，現在可以隨手折疊次要章節，還能把同一次施工的多處修改彙整在同一份清單。⟧現在按下快捷鍵 `f` 可以切換顯示整份檔案，按下 `Ctrl+O` 則能折疊個別變更區塊（hunk，版本控制中連續的一段程式碼修改）。在 Per Turn 檢視中，同一輪對話內對同一檔案進行的多次編輯，會直接合併為單一比對畫面，不再被拆得零散。清單顯示的排版問題也已修復，清單中超出終端機寬度的長行會正常截斷而不再強行折行，Per Turn 頂部標題也不會再把提示詞截斷在 50 個字元。
body.en: When typing `/diff` in the terminal to inspect code changes, Commit Tree and Per Turn views add several reading controls. ⟦Like consulting a bound set of engineering blueprints where you previously had to spread out entire pages to search for details, you can now collapse secondary sections at will and consolidate edits from the same job into a single list.⟧ Pressing `f` now toggles the full file view, while `Ctrl+O` folds an individual hunk (a contiguous section of code changes in version control). In Per Turn view, multiple edits made to the same file within a single turn merge directly into a unified diff screen instead of being scattered. List formatting issues are also fixed: lines exceeding terminal width now truncate cleanly rather than wrapping forcefully, and Per Turn headers no longer truncate prompts at 50 characters.

items.original:
Added whole-file toggle (`f`) and hunk folding (`Ctrl+O`) to `Commit Tree` and `Per Turn` views in `/diff`, and consolidated `Per Turn` diffs so multiple edits to a file in one turn appear as a single combined diff.
Fixed long rows wrapping instead of truncating at the terminal width in `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` and `Per Turn` lists, and `Per Turn` headers truncating prompts at 50 characters.

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具呼叫支援追溯最上層對話，清理伺服器連線洩漏
title.en: MCP Tool Calls Support Root Conversation Tracing, Fixing Server Connection Leaks

body.zh-TW: 當你使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）串接自訂伺服器時，子代理呼叫工具的追蹤能力有了重大改善。⟦就像委託跨國快遞寄件，以前轉交給各區投遞員後就查不到源頭，現在每筆派工紀錄都烙印總單號，無論轉發幾手都能追溯最初的寄件委託。⟧現在即使工具是由深層的巢狀子代理所觸發，發出的 `tools/call` 請求都會自動帶上 `_meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"]` 欄位，讓外部伺服器能辨識最頂層的對話識別碼。在伺服器連線與資源釋放方面，先前若在伺服器啟動期間執行 `tools/list` 失敗，或是在連線尚未完成時直接關閉命令列工具，背景連線常式與用戶端工作階段容易殘留。這兩種情況造成的用戶端工作階段與背景連線常式洩漏，現在已修好。
body.en: When connecting custom servers with MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools), tracking tool calls made by subagents is substantially improved. ⟦Think of shipping a package through an international courier: previously, handoffs to regional delivery agents obscured the origin, but now every dispatch record stamps a master tracking number so the initial request remains traceable across any number of transfers.⟧ Even when tools are invoked by deeply nested subagents, outgoing `tools/call` requests now automatically include the `_meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"]` field so external servers can identify the top-level conversation ID. In terms of server connections and resource cleanup, background connection routines and client sessions previously lingered if `tools/list` failed during startup or if the CLI closed before the connection finished. Leaks of client sessions and background connection routines caused by both scenarios are now resolved.

items.original:
Added `_meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"]` to MCP `tools/call` requests so MCP servers receive the top-level conversation ID even when a tool is called from a nested subagent.
Fixed MCP client sessions and background connection routines leaking when `tools/list` failed during server startup or when the CLI shut down while a server was connecting.

title.zh-TW: 外掛程式驗證加強嚴格檢查，修復子代理繼承與技能重複載入
title.en: Plugin Validation Enforces Stricter Checks, Fixing Subagent Inheritance and Skill Duplication

body.zh-TW:
在開發或安裝自訂擴充套件時，外掛程式的驗證機制與執行環境獲得了多項修正。

指令 `agy plugin validate` 導入更嚴格的檢查，全面檢驗 `plugin.json`、MCP 伺服器設定、`hooks.json` 與 sidecar 清單，防範無效 JSON 語法、未知欄位、錯誤變數佔位符、無法辨識的掛鉤（hook，事件觸發時執行的自動腳本）工具比對器及遺失腳本。

子代理方面，修復了子代理遺失父工作階段繼承外掛的問題；若打包外掛的子代理設定 `plugins.inherit_user: false` 且限制 MCP 工具，先前啟動拋出 `mcp spec not found for provider` 的異常也已修復。

當自訂規則或 `SKILL.md` 技能同時存在於獨立客製化資料夾與已啟用外掛程式時，系統不再重複載入兩次。
body.en:
When developing or installing custom extensions, plugin validation mechanisms and execution environments received multiple fixes.

The `agy plugin validate` command introduces stricter checks that thoroughly inspect `plugin.json`, MCP server configurations, `hooks.json`, and sidecar manifests, guarding against invalid JSON syntax, unknown fields, malformed variable placeholders, unrecognized tool matchers for hooks (automated scripts triggered by specific events), and missing scripts.

For subagents, an issue where subagents lost plugins inherited from parent sessions has been resolved. If a packaged plugin subagent sets `plugins.inherit_user: false` and restricts MCP tools, the startup error throwing `mcp spec not found for provider` is also fixed.

When custom rules or `SKILL.md` skills exist simultaneously in standalone customization folders and enabled plugins, the system no longer loads them twice.

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin validate` with stricter checks across `plugin.json`, MCP server configs, `hooks.json`, and sidecar manifests for invalid JSON syntax, unknown fields, bad variable placeholders, unrecognized hook tool matchers, and missing hook scripts.
Fixed subagents losing plugins inherited from the parent session, and fixed plugin-bundled subagents with `plugins.inherit_user: false` and restricted MCP tools failing to start with `mcp spec not found for provider`.
Fixed rules and `SKILL.md` skills loading twice when discovered from both a standalone customization folder and an enabled plugin.

title.zh-TW: 串流回應暫存降低資源消耗，壓縮請求保留工具宣告重用快取
title.en: Stream Response Caching Cuts Resource Overhead, Compaction Retains Tool Declarations

body.zh-TW: 當你請模型生成長篇回應或修改大量程式碼時，回應串流與對話壓縮的快取（cache，把處理過的結果暫存起來重複使用）機制減輕了運算負擔。⟦好比在料理檯旁備妥常備菜，已切洗好的食材直接下鍋而不重複動刀，收拾廚房時也把標準菜單留在黑板上，省去重新謄寫核對的時間。⟧在文字串流輸出期間，終端機現在會跨影格暫存程式碼區塊的語法標記（token，程式碼結構的分析記號）、算繪後的 Markdown 區塊，以及行內檔案編輯的確認比對畫面，降低 CPU 與記憶體使用量。而在執行 `/compact` 指令或系統觸發自動壓縮時，對話摘要請求會完整保留工具宣告，讓模型 API 能順暢重複使用先前已快取的提示詞前綴。
body.en: When asking models to generate lengthy responses or modify extensive code, caching mechanisms for response streaming and conversation compaction reduce computing overhead. ⟦Imagine keeping prepped ingredients ready by the kitchen counter, where washed and chopped items drop straight into the pot without re-cutting, while standard menus stay on the chalkboard during cleanup to save time re-copying.⟧ During streamed text output, the terminal now caches code-block syntax tokens (structural analysis units for code) across frames, along with rendered Markdown blocks and inline file edit confirmation diffs, lowering CPU and memory usage. When running `/compact` or when the system triggers automatic compaction, conversation summary requests preserve tool declarations intact, allowing model APIs to smoothly reuse previously cached prompt prefixes.

items.original:
Improved CPU and memory usage while streaming responses by caching streamed code-block syntax tokens, rendered Markdown blocks, and inline file-edit confirmation diffs across frames.
Improved `/compact` and automatic compaction to retain tool declarations on summarization requests so the model API reuses its cached prompt prefix.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 支援平板多欄排版，修正行動端介面與算繪錯誤
title.en: Remote Control Adds Multi-Column Layout on Tablets, Fixing Mobile UI and Rendering Bugs

body.zh-TW:
在平板與行動裝置上使用 Remote Control 遠端控制時，大螢幕排版與多項操作體驗獲得整體升級。

平板與摺疊螢幕裝置不再強制縮成單欄手機畫面，而是啟用具備觸控尺寸控制項的多欄排版，拖曳捲軸時彈出的控制面板（popover）也會持續保持開啟。

行動端的介面細節也獲得修正。手機上標題與對話框遭截斷、iOS Safari 點選輸入框時畫面被自動放大、設定載入中 Enable Telemetry 與 Marketing Emails 開關自行跳回，以及拖曳網址時遺失查詢參數或井字標記（#）的問題已全數排除。

輸出算繪與檔案匯出同樣更為穩定。先前巢狀程式碼區塊排版破裂、帶錢字號的 Shell 變數（$VAR）被誤判為 LaTeX 公式、媒體預覽無法載入、複製圖片或匯出 PDF 時圖表模糊或空白，以及背景分頁計時器偏差等現象，現在都已修正完畢。
body.en:
When using Remote Control on tablets and mobile devices, large-screen layouts and various operational experiences received an overall upgrade.

Tablets and foldable devices are no longer forced into a single-column phone view; instead, they enable a multi-column layout with touch-sized controls, and popover panels remain open while dragging scrollbars.

Mobile interface details have also been refined. Issues where titles and dialogs truncated on phones, tapping input fields in iOS Safari triggered automatic zoom, the Enable Telemetry and Marketing Emails toggles flipped back while settings loaded, and dragging URLs lost query parameters or hashes (#) are all resolved.

Output rendering and file exports are likewise more stable. Prior issues with broken nested code block layouts, Shell variables ($VAR) being misidentified as LaTeX formulas, media previews failing to load, blurry or blank charts when copying images or exporting PDFs, and background tab timer drift have all been fixed.

items.original:
Improved Remote Control on tablets and foldables to use the multi-pane layout with touch-sized controls instead of collapsing to the phone view, and kept popovers open while dragging scrollbars.
Fixed several UI issues in Remote Control, including clipped headers and dialogs on phones, iOS Safari zoom on input focus, `Enable Telemetry` and `Marketing Emails` reverting while Settings loads, and dragged URLs losing query or `#` parameters.
Fixed rendering and export bugs in Remote Control, including broken nested code blocks, `$VAR` shell variables parsed as LaTeX, broken media previews, blurry or blank diagrams in `Copy Image` and `Export as PDF`, and background-tab timer drift.

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入框回歸底部定位，修復 Ctrl+Z 復原與表情符號截斷
title.en: Terminal Input Box Re-Anchors to Bottom, Fixing Ctrl+Z Undo and Emoji Truncation

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中與模型對話時，輸入框的排版位置與文字復原行為迎來了重要修正。⟦正如在紙上書寫與擦拭草稿，以前橡皮擦常常擦掉多餘的字跡甚至弄縐紙張，現在每一次復原動作都能精準撤回上一筆紀錄。⟧先前當你關閉面板、下拉選單或行內提示時，輸入框有時會卡在螢幕中間不回彈，在 Medium 詳細度模式下輸入框上方還會出現空白縫隙；現在這些排版異常都已修復，輸入列會穩定貼齊底部。文字編輯方面，快捷鍵 Ctrl+Z 的復原機制已重新調整。過去貼上文字時復原容易錯亂，新輸入的內容甚至會與歷史紀錄錯誤合併。現在無作用的退格鍵與 Delete 不再被記錄為多餘步驟，在表情符號（emoji）旁執行刪除或復原時，也不會再發生字元遭到截斷的狀況。
body.en: When chatting with models in the terminal, the input box layout position and text undo behavior received major fixes. ⟦A writer sketching and erasing drafts on paper once risked smudging extra marks or wrinkling the sheet, but now each undo step accurately retracts the previous entry.⟧ Previously, closing panels, dropdown menus, or inline prompts could leave the input box stuck midway up the screen, and a blank gap appeared above the input box in Medium verbosity mode; these layout anomalies are now resolved, keeping the input bar securely anchored to the bottom. For text editing, the Ctrl+Z undo mechanism has been retuned. Pasting text previously scrambled undo history, sometimes incorrectly merging newly typed content with older history. Ineffective Backspace and Delete keystrokes are no longer recorded as extra steps, and deleting or undoing next to emojis (pictographic symbols) no longer causes characters to be truncated.

items.original:
Fixed the prompt box staying mid-screen after closing panels, dropdowns, or inline prompts, and blank gaps appearing above the prompt in `Medium` verbosity mode.
Fixed `Ctrl+Z` undo in the prompt mishandling pasted text, merging typing with recalled history entries, recording no-op `Backspace` or `Delete` steps, and truncating characters near emoji.

title.zh-TW: 修正規則優先順序措辭，明確涵蓋前方內建指示
title.en: Clarify Rule Precedence Phrasing to Explicitly Cover Earlier Built-In Instructions

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案根目錄撰寫自訂規範時，可以留意系統提示詞對規則優先順序的說明。以前系統提示詞（system prompt，引導 AI 行為的核心指示）的措辭，只寫出 GEMINI.md 與 AGENTS.md 的使用者規則可覆寫排在它們後方的指示。現在系統提示詞明確寫出 GEMINI.md 與 AGENTS.md 規則可覆寫較早出現的內建指示。
body.en: When writing custom rules in project roots, note the updated system prompt phrasing for rule precedence. Phrasing in the system prompt (core instructions guiding AI behavior) previously only stated that user rules in GEMINI.md and AGENTS.md could override instructions placed after them. The system prompt now explicitly clarifies that GEMINI.md and AGENTS.md rules can override earlier built-in instructions.

items.original: Fixed the system prompt's user rules wording so `GEMINI.md` and `AGENTS.md` rules explicitly override earlier built-in instructions instead of only instructions that follow them.

title.zh-TW: 支援帶編碼參數的媒體附件，避免音訊檔案遭錯誤拒絕
title.en: Support Media Attachments with Codec Parameters, Preventing Erroneous Audio Rejections

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機對話中上傳音訊或多媒體檔案時，附件格式的相容性獲得了修正。以前若媒體附件的 MIME 類型（標示附件內容格式的類型名稱）帶有額外參數，例如常見的音訊格式 audio/webm; codecs=opus，會被誤判為不支援而直接遭到拒絕。這類原本受支援的附件，現在不會再因 MIME 類型帶有參數而被誤拒。
body.en: When uploading audio or multimedia files in terminal conversations, attachment format compatibility has been fixed. Previously, if a media attachment's MIME type (a label identifying attachment content formats) included extra parameters, such as the common audio format audio/webm; codecs=opus, it was incorrectly flagged as unsupported and rejected. Such natively supported attachments are no longer falsely rejected due to parameterized MIME types.

items.original: Fixed supported media attachments with parameterized MIME types such as `audio/webm; codecs=opus` being rejected as unsupported.

entries: Added `/` search to the `/diff` file list and file view: matches are highlighted as you type, the search prompt shows how many matches the diff and each file contain, `Enter` jumps to the first match, and `n`/`N` step through matches one at a time across every file, with `match A/B` in the file view header. `n`/`N` in the artifact viewer now also step through matches one at a time, including several on the same line, instead of jumping from line to line.

Improved `agy plugin validate` to also check a plugin's hooks, sidecars, and component lists: it reports an error when `hooks.json`, a `sidecar.json`, or a `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `agents.json`, or `sidecars.json` file can't be parsed, and warns about unknown hook events, hook matchers that aren't valid regular expressions and so never match, a `hooks/hooks.json` file (which isn't read), list entries with no path or with a path missing from the plugin, `commands/` folders and `workflows/` Markdown files (which plugins don't load), and a Claude Code-style top-level `"hooks"` key, which loads as a single hook named `hooks`.
Improved timer labels in `/tasks` and the active task list to show durations in days, hours, minutes, and seconds, such as `1d 2h timer` or `5m timer`, instead of raw seconds such as `93784s timer`.
Fixed Gemini 4 Argon not shown in `/model` and `--model` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`.
Fixed the CLI offering options that need the terminal sandbox on systems where it can't run, such as Linux systems that block unprivileged user namespaces and Windows before Windows 11 24H2.

Fixed subagents and custom agents in Auto mode asking you to approve every command that would leave the terminal sandbox; like the main agent's, their commands are now first reviewed by a separate agent, so safe commands run without asking and risky ones still prompt you.

Fixed the agent losing track of its most recently started subagents after a conversation was compacted, because the summary included each subagent's full initial prompt and was cut off before their conversation IDs; the summary now keeps only each subagent's type, role, and result, which also leaves more room in the context window.

Fixed a `PostToolUse` hook that fails to run, for example because its command is missing, exits with an error, times out, or prints invalid JSON, marking the tool call it follows as failed even though the tool succeeded; the failure is now logged and the tool keeps its result.

Fixed the agent failing to create empty files such as `__init__.py` or `.gitkeep`, and failing to write or edit regular project files with `... is not a valid artifact path` when the model sent blank artifact details.

Fixed updating or reinstalling a marketplace plugin on Windows leaving it half-deleted when another `agy` session, the Antigravity desktop app, or the Remote Control background service had it open; the installed plugin now stays intact until the new copy is in place, and the previous version is restored if the replacement fails.

Fixed `agy plugin install` and `agy plugin import` writing color codes into piped or redirected output, ignoring `NO_COLOR`, and showing raw codes in older Windows consoles; like `agy plugin validate`, they now use color only in a terminal and follow `NO_COLOR`, `CLICOLOR`, and `CLICOLOR_FORCE`.

Fixed Remote Control on iPhone and iPad asking you to accept the `Security Notice & Data Use` terms and showing the `Enable Notifications` prompt again every time you reopened it; it now remembers your answers, along with your theme, layout, and dismissed tips.

Fixed the prompt cursor appearing in the wrong place after resizing the terminal (sometimes on the `↑ N more lines` indicator or below the input box), when a slash command's completion hint didn't fit on the last line of the prompt (the hint is now shortened or left out), when the prompt was taller than the terminal, after pressing `Up` or `Down` onto a line with CJK characters or emoji, and after entering Vim visual mode, which also rewrapped the text.

Fixed the cursor drifting on lines with emoji such as 👩‍💻, 👍🏽, or ⚠️ inside tmux 3.6 and later, and after returning from your external editor (`Ctrl+G`) or a `Ctrl+Z` suspend in terminals that support grapheme-cluster widths.

Fixed the cursor drifting and lines wrapping too early under Japanese, Chinese, or Korean locales such as `LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8` when text contains characters like `→`, `…`, `─`, or `•`, which parts of the CLI counted as two columns wide while the rest drew them as one.

Fixed `Left`, `Right`, `Backspace`, and `Delete` in the prompt and other text boxes moving over or deleting only part of an emoji such as 👩‍💻 or 👍🏽, a flag, or a letter with a combining accent, and fixed text boxes cutting off a wide character, such as a CJK character or emoji, at the end of a wrapped line instead of moving it to the next line.

Fixed lines containing combining marks or other zero-width characters wrapping too early or leaving blank rows in `/diff` and the inline diff preview, and being cut off with `…` too soon in `/artifact` previews.

title.zh-TW: /diff 與產物檢視器新增搜尋功能，支援跨檔案逐筆跳轉
title.en: /diff and Artifact Viewer Add Search with Cross-File Match Navigation

body.zh-TW: 比對大批修改內容時，要在冗長的變更清單中精準定位某個函式或變數往往相當費時。在 `/diff` 的檔案清單與檔案檢視中，按下 `/` 即可啟動搜尋。輸入關鍵字時會即時反白相符字串，提示列還會列出整份差異比對與各檔案分別包含多少筆相符項目。按下 `Enter` 會跳到第一筆結果，接著按 `n` 或 `N` 就能跨檔案逐筆來回巡覽，頁首也會顯示如 `match A/B` 的進度指示。⟦尋訪長篇族譜名冊時，以前只能逐頁掃描而容易看漏同行的重複名字；現在輸入字根便立刻標記全冊，提示列載明各章節出現次數，還能依序巡禮每個相符人名。⟧在產物檢視器（artifact viewer，用來預覽生成文件的面板）中按 `n` 與 `N`，現在也會逐筆跳過同一行內的多個項目，不再整行跳躍。
body.en: When reviewing large sets of changes, pinpointing a specific function or variable across a lengthy change list is often time-consuming. In the file list and file view of `/diff`, pressing `/` starts a search. Typing keywords highlights matching strings in real time, while the prompt bar lists total matches across the diff and per file. Pressing `Enter` jumps to the first result, and pressing `n` or `N` navigates back and forth between matches across files, with the header showing progress indicators like `match A/B`. ⟦When searching through a lengthy genealogy registry, people previously had to scan page by page and easily missed duplicate names on the same line; now, typing a root immediately highlights the entire registry, with a prompt bar showing the number of occurrences per chapter, and lets you browse each matching name in sequence.⟧ In the artifact viewer (a panel used to preview generated documents), pressing `n` and `N` now also steps through multiple matches on the same line rather than skipping entire lines.

items.original: Added `/` search to the `/diff` file list and file view: matches are highlighted as you type, the search prompt shows how many matches the diff and each file contain, `Enter` jumps to the first match, and `n`/`N` step through matches one at a time across every file, with `match A/B` in the file view header. `n`/`N` in the artifact viewer now also step through matches one at a time, including several on the same line, instead of jumping from line to line.

title.zh-TW: 外掛驗證新增結構檢查，修正 Windows 覆寫防護與顏色輸出
title.en: Plugin Validation Adds Structural Checks, Fixing Windows Overwrite Protection and Color Output

body.zh-TW:
外掛設定疏漏或檔案被佔用以往容易導致異常。`agy plugin validate` 新增結構檢查：無法解析 `hooks.json`、`sidecar.json` 或元件清單時報錯；遇未知掛鉤、無效正規表達式（用符號比對字串）、未讀取的 `hooks/hooks.json`、遺漏路徑、不載入的 `commands/` 與 `workflows/` 或頂層 `"hooks"` 鍵名則警告。

在 Windows 更新或重裝外掛時，若被其他工作階段佔用，以前會留下半刪除毀損目錄；新版就位前舊版維持完整，替換失敗也會還原。

`agy plugin install` 與 `agy plugin import` 修正了導向輸出夾帶色碼的問題，現在只在終端機著色，並遵循 `NO_COLOR`、`CLICOLOR` 與 `CLICOLOR_FORCE`。
body.en:
Oversights in plugin configuration or occupied files previously caused errors. `agy plugin validate` adds structural checks, reporting errors if `hooks.json`, `sidecar.json`, or component manifests cannot be parsed. It warns on unknown hooks, unread `hooks/hooks.json`, missing paths, unloaded `commands/` and `workflows/`, or top-level `"hooks"` keys. It also warns on invalid regular expressions (patterns used to match strings).

When updating or reinstalling plugins on Windows, if files were locked by another session, a half-deleted corrupted directory was previously left behind. The old version now remains intact until the new version is in place, and rolls back if replacement fails.

`agy plugin install` and `agy plugin import` fix an issue where redirected output included color escape codes. Output is now colored only in the terminal, respecting `NO_COLOR`, `CLICOLOR`, and `CLICOLOR_FORCE`.

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin validate` to also check a plugin's hooks, sidecars, and component lists: it reports an error when `hooks.json`, a `sidecar.json`, or a `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `agents.json`, or `sidecars.json` file can't be parsed, and warns about unknown hook events, hook matchers that aren't valid regular expressions and so never match, a `hooks/hooks.json` file (which isn't read), list entries with no path or with a path missing from the plugin, `commands/` folders and `workflows/` Markdown files (which plugins don't load), and a Claude Code-style top-level `"hooks"` key, which loads as a single hook named `hooks`.
Fixed updating or reinstalling a marketplace plugin on Windows leaving it half-deleted when another `agy` session, the Antigravity desktop app, or the Remote Control background service had it open; the installed plugin now stays intact until the new copy is in place, and the previous version is restored if the replacement fails.
Fixed `agy plugin install` and `agy plugin import` writing color codes into piped or redirected output, ignoring `NO_COLOR`, and showing raw codes in older Windows consoles; like `agy plugin validate`, they now use color only in a terminal and follow `NO_COLOR`, `CLICOLOR`, and `CLICOLOR_FORCE`.

title.zh-TW: /tasks 計時器改以天時分秒顯示，清楚掌握剩餘時間
title.en: /tasks Timers Switch to Days, Hours, Minutes, and Seconds for Clearer Remaining Time

body.zh-TW: 當你在背景啟動了長時間排程，隨時掌握任務的等待時間是安排後續工作的關鍵。在終端機查看進行中的排程計時器時，時間標示方式直接影響你掌握進度的速度。在 `/tasks` 任務清單與作用中任務清單中，計時器標籤現在改以天、小時、分鐘與秒數來顯示時間長度，例如呈現為 `1d 2h timer` 或 `5m timer`。以前這裡只會顯示原始秒數，像是 `93784s timer`，讓人難以一眼看出到底還要等多久。⟦盯著大樓停車場的繳費機螢幕，以前停留時間只顯示幾萬秒讓人摸不著頭緒；現在直接換算成幾天幾小時幾分幾秒，一眼就能看清車輛停放了多久。⟧當你設定了排程任務時，只要在對話中輸入 `/tasks`，就能立刻從清單看到以天或分鐘標示的計時器，不必再自行拿計算機換算秒數。
body.en: When running long-running schedules in the background, keeping track of task waiting time is key to planning subsequent work. When checking active scheduled timers in the terminal, the time display format directly affects how quickly you grasp progress. In the `/tasks` task list and active tasks list, timer labels now display durations in days, hours, minutes, and seconds, appearing as `1d 2h timer` or `5m timer`. Previously, this displayed only raw seconds like `93784s timer`, making it hard to tell at a glance how much waiting time remained. ⟦Picture the screen of a parking payment machine, where parking duration previously showed only tens of thousands of seconds and left drivers baffled; now it directly converts into days, hours, minutes, and seconds, making it obvious at a glance how long a vehicle has been parked.⟧ When you configure scheduled tasks, simply typing `/tasks` in a conversation lets you immediately see timers labeled in days or minutes from the list, without needing a calculator to convert seconds yourself.

items.original: Improved timer labels in `/tasks` and the active task list to show durations in days, hours, minutes, and seconds, such as `1d 2h timer` or `5m timer`, instead of raw seconds such as `93784s timer`.

title.zh-TW: 修復以金鑰連線時未顯示 Gemini 4 Argon 的問題
title.en: Fix Missing Gemini 4 Argon When Connecting with an API Key

body.zh-TW: 習慣使用個人 API 金鑰切換模型時，可用清單若漏列特定選項會影響工作調度。當你透過環境變數 `GEMINI_API_KEY`（Gemini 服務的存取金鑰）連線時，先前在切換模型的 `/model` 指令選單以及 `--model` 啟動參數中，都沒有列出 Gemini 4 Argon 模型。現在這個問題已經修好，以金鑰連線時也能正常在選單與參數中指定該模型。
body.en: When you are accustomed to switching models using a personal API key, missing options from the available list disrupt workflow planning. When connecting through the `GEMINI_API_KEY` environment variable (the access key for Gemini services), the Gemini 4 Argon model was previously omitted from the `/model` command selection menu and the `--model` launch flag. This issue is now resolved, and you can properly select the model from the menu and specify it via the flag when connecting with an API key.

items.original: Fixed Gemini 4 Argon not shown in `/model` and `--model` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`.

title.zh-TW: 不支援沙盒的作業系統不再列出終端機沙盒選項
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Options Omitted on Operating Systems Lacking Sandbox Support

body.zh-TW: 在不支援終端機沙盒（隔離執行指令的受限環境）的電腦上打開 CLI，本來就用不了的選項不該出現在選單裡。這類系統包括阻擋非特權使用者命名空間的 Linux 系統，以及 Windows 11 24H2 之前的舊版 Windows，以前命令列介面仍會提供需要沙盒支援的選項。這個問題已經修好，不支援沙盒的系統上不會再看到需要沙盒的選項。
body.en: When opening the CLI on a machine that does not support a terminal sandbox (a restricted environment that isolates command execution), unusable options should not appear in the menu. Such systems include Linux systems blocking unprivileged user namespaces and versions of Windows prior to Windows 11 24H2, where the command-line interface previously still offered options requiring sandbox support. This issue has been resolved, and systems without sandbox support will no longer display options requiring a sandbox.

items.original: Fixed the CLI offering options that need the terminal sandbox on systems where it can't run, such as Linux systems that block unprivileged user namespaces and Windows before Windows 11 24H2.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式子代理指令改由獨立代理審核，安全操作免手動核准
title.en: Auto-Mode Subagent Commands Reviewed by Independent Agent, Allowing Safe Operations Without Manual Approval

body.zh-TW: 讓代理在背景自動排解複雜任務時，頻繁跳出確認提示會打斷原本流暢的工作流程。在自動模式下，子代理（subagent，負責分流特定任務的輔助代理）與自訂代理以往只要執行脫離終端機沙盒的指令，每次都會停下來要求你手動核准。現在比照主代理的處理機制，它們的指令會先由另一個獨立代理負責審核。安全指令會直接執行，只有具備潛在風險的操作才會跳出提示向你確認。
body.en: When letting agents automatically handle complex tasks in the background, frequent confirmation prompts interrupt an otherwise smooth workflow. In auto mode, subagents (auxiliary agents that handle specific tasks) and custom agents previously paused to require manual approval every time they executed a command outside the terminal sandbox. Matching the behavior of the main agent, their commands are now reviewed first by an independent agent. Safe commands run directly, and only potentially risky operations prompt you for confirmation.

items.original: Fixed subagents and custom agents in Auto mode asking you to approve every command that would leave the terminal sandbox; like the main agent's, their commands are now first reviewed by a separate agent, so safe commands run without asking and risky ones still prompt you.

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮保留子代理編號，精簡摘要不再丟失背景任務
title.en: Conversation Compaction Preserves Subagent IDs, Preventing Compacted Summaries from Losing Background Tasks

body.zh-TW: 長時間對話進行壓縮整理時，歷史任務資訊若被截斷，會讓代理遺忘先前派出的幫手。以前對話摘要會塞入每個子代理完整的初始提示詞，往往因為長度超限而在記錄對話編號（conversation ID）前就被截斷，導致代理失去對近期子代理的追蹤。現在壓縮摘要只保留各子代理的類型、角色與執行結果，確保識別資訊完整留存，並為語境視窗（context window，模型一次能讀取的記憶上限）留出更多空間。
body.en: When compacting and summarizing long conversations, truncated historical task information causes the agent to forget previously delegated helpers. Previously, conversation summaries included the full initial prompts for each subagent, which frequently exceeded length limits and were truncated before recording conversation IDs, causing the agent to lose track of recent subagents. Compacted summaries now retain only the type, role, and execution results of each subagent, ensuring identifiers are preserved while freeing up space for the context window (the maximum memory a model can read at one time).

items.original: Fixed the agent losing track of its most recently started subagents after a conversation was compacted, because the summary included each subagent's full initial prompt and was cut off before their conversation IDs; the summary now keeps only each subagent's type, role, and result, which also leaves more room in the context window.

title.zh-TW: PostToolUse 掛鉤失敗改為記錄日誌，不再將工具誤判為失敗
title.en: PostToolUse Hook Failures Now Logged Rather Than Misreporting Tool Failures

body.zh-TW: 設定工具執行的後續連動時，附加檢查腳本若發生異常，不應影響主要操作的成敗判定。在工具呼叫後觸發的 `PostToolUse` 掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）若執行失敗，例如指令不存在、執行逾時、退出回傳錯誤或輸出無效的 JSON，以前會將原本成功的工具呼叫直接標記為失敗。現在這類失敗只會記錄在日誌中，工具會完整保留原本的執行成果。
body.en: When configuring post-execution actions for tools, errors in supplemental check scripts should not affect the outcome of the primary operation. If `PostToolUse` hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) failed after a tool call—such as from a missing command, execution timeout, non-zero exit code, or invalid JSON output—the system previously marked an otherwise successful tool call as failed. Such failures are now recorded only in logs, leaving the original tool results fully intact.

items.original: Fixed a `PostToolUse` hook that fails to run, for example because its command is missing, exits with an error, times out, or prints invalid JSON, marking the tool call it follows as failed even though the tool succeeded; the failure is now logged and the tool keeps its result.

title.zh-TW: 修復空白檔案建立失敗，以及專案寫入誤報產物路徑的問題
title.en: Fix Empty File Creation Failures and Erroneous Artifact Path Errors on Project Writes

body.zh-TW: 讓代理建立新模組或初始化目錄時，建立標記檔案與修改專案內容是常見的操作。以前代理在建立如 `__init__.py` 或 `.gitkeep` 等空白檔案時會執行失敗，而且當模型送出空白的產物資訊時，寫入或編輯一般專案檔案也會跳出 `... is not a valid artifact path` 的報錯。現在這個問題已經修好，建立零內容檔案與正常編輯專案檔案都能順利完成。
body.en: When having an agent create new modules or initialize directories, generating marker files and modifying project contents are common operations. Previously, agents failed when creating empty files such as `__init__.py` or `.gitkeep`. In addition, writing or editing normal project files threw a `... is not a valid artifact path` error whenever the model sent blank artifact information. This issue is now resolved, allowing both zero-content file creation and standard project file editing to complete smoothly.

items.original: Fixed the agent failing to create empty files such as `__init__.py` or `.gitkeep`, and failing to write or edit regular project files with `... is not a valid artifact path` when the model sent blank artifact details.

title.zh-TW: iPhone 與 iPad 遠端控制支援狀態記憶，不再重複提示條款與通知
title.en: Remote Control on iPhone and iPad Adds State Persistence, Ending Repeated Terms and Notification Prompts

body.zh-TW: 在行動裝置上透過遠端功能查看進度時，每次開啟都必須手動關閉重複的提示視窗相當不便。在 iPhone 與 iPad 上使用 Remote Control（遠端控制功能）時，以前每次重新開啟，都會重複要求同意 `Security Notice & Data Use` 安全與資料使用條款，並再次彈出 `Enable Notifications` 啟用通知提示。現在應用程式會記住你的回覆，連同主題、排版設定以及已關閉的提示一併儲存。
body.en: When monitoring progress remotely on mobile devices, having to manually dismiss repetitive modal dialogs upon every launch is frustrating. When using Remote Control on iPhone and iPad, reopening previously prompted users to accept the `Security Notice & Data Use` terms again and popped up the `Enable Notifications` prompt each time. The application now remembers your responses, saving them alongside your theme, layout preferences, and dismissed prompts.

items.original: Fixed Remote Control on iPhone and iPad asking you to accept the `Security Notice & Data Use` terms and showing the `Enable Notifications` prompt again every time you reopened it; it now remembers your answers, along with your theme, layout, and dismissed tips.

title.zh-TW: 修復終端機游標錯位與換行，完善表情符號與多語字元排版
title.en: Fix terminal cursor misalignment and line wrapping, improving emoji and multilingual character layouts

body.zh-TW:
在終端機處理多國文字與圖示時，字寬計算誤差常導致游標跑位或排版錯亂。

調整視窗（停在 `↑ N more lines` 或框外）、提示過高、按上下鍵移至中日韓或表情符號，以及進入 Vim 視覺模式時游標不再錯位，過長的補全提示也會自動縮短。

在支援圖素叢集寬度的終端機中，從外部編輯器（`Ctrl+G`）或 `Ctrl+Z` 返回後及在 tmux 3.6+ 下，含 👩💻、👍🏽、⚠️ 的行不再漂移。在日中韓語系（如 `LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8`）下含 `→`、`…`、`─`、`•` 時的漂移與提早折行也一併修復。

按方向鍵、`Backspace` 或 `Delete` 不再只刪改半個表情符號、旗幟或變音字母，行末寬字元也會正確折行。在 `/diff` 與 `/artifact` 預覽中，結合符號或零寬字元導致提早折行、空白列或過早以 `…` 截斷也已修好。
body.en:
When handling multilingual text and symbols in the terminal, character width calculation errors often lead to cursor displacement or layout glitches.

The cursor no longer misaligns when resizing the window (resting on `↑ N more lines` or outside the frame), when prompts are excessively tall, when pressing Up or Down keys across CJK characters or emojis, or when entering Vim visual mode. Excessively long completion hints will also automatically shrink.

In terminals supporting grapheme cluster widths, lines containing 👩💻, 👍🏽, or ⚠️ no longer drift after returning from an external editor (`Ctrl+G`) or `Ctrl+Z`, or under tmux 3.6+. Drifting and premature line wraps when containing `→`, `…`, `─`, or `•` under CJK locales (such as `LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8`) have also been fixed.

Pressing arrow keys, `Backspace`, or `Delete` no longer modifies or deletes half of an emoji, flag, or accented letter, and wide characters at line ends now wrap correctly. In `/diff` and `/artifact` previews, premature line wrapping, blank lines, or early truncation with `…` caused by combining characters or zero-width characters have also been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed the prompt cursor appearing in the wrong place after resizing the terminal (sometimes on the `↑ N more lines` indicator or below the input box), when a slash command's completion hint didn't fit on the last line of the prompt (the hint is now shortened or left out), when the prompt was taller than the terminal, after pressing `Up` or `Down` onto a line with CJK characters or emoji, and after entering Vim visual mode, which also rewrapped the text.
Fixed the cursor drifting on lines with emoji such as 👩‍💻, 👍🏽, or ⚠️ inside tmux 3.6 and later, and after returning from your external editor (`Ctrl+G`) or a `Ctrl+Z` suspend in terminals that support grapheme-cluster widths.
Fixed the cursor drifting and lines wrapping too early under Japanese, Chinese, or Korean locales such as `LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8` when text contains characters like `→`, `…`, `─`, or `•`, which parts of the CLI counted as two columns wide while the rest drew them as one.
Fixed `Left`, `Right`, `Backspace`, and `Delete` in the prompt and other text boxes moving over or deleting only part of an emoji such as 👩‍💻 or 👍🏽, a flag, or a letter with a combining accent, and fixed text boxes cutting off a wide character, such as a CJK character or emoji, at the end of a wrapped line instead of moving it to the next line.
Fixed lines containing combining marks or other zero-width characters wrapping too early or leaving blank rows in `/diff` and the inline diff preview, and being cut off with `…` too soon in `/artifact` previews.

entries: Fixed conversation history not showing in Remote Control in daemon mode.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 在 daemon 模式下能正常顯示對話紀錄
title.en: Remote Control Displays Conversation History Properly in Daemon Mode

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣將工具以 daemon（在背景持續運作的服務）模式啟動，再透過 Remote Control 遠端操控介面查看進度，可能曾遇過找不到過去紀錄的狀況。以前在這種背景情境下，Remote Control 不會顯示先前的對話紀錄。現在這個問題已經修復，在 daemon 模式下對話紀錄會正常顯示。
body.en: If you usually launch the tool in daemon mode and check progress through the Remote Control interface, you might have run into cases where past records could not be found. Previously in these background scenarios, Remote Control did not display prior conversation history. This issue has now been fixed, and conversation history displays properly in daemon mode.

items.original: Fixed conversation history not showing in Remote Control in daemon mode.

entries: Improved `agy plugin validate` to also check a plugin's skills, subagents, and rules: for skills, it errors on a `SKILL.md` with missing or invalid frontmatter and warns when `name` or `description` is missing, when `name` doesn't match its folder, when the body is over the 24 KB limit, or when a skill in `skills/` is skipped because an earlier skill has the same name; for subagents, it errors on an `agents/` Markdown file with invalid frontmatter or a missing `name` or `description`, an unparseable `agent.json`, or a name reserved for a built-in agent, and warns on duplicate agent names, Markdown files in `agents/` without frontmatter, and `agent.json` files, which the CLI ignores; and for rules, it errors on a rule with invalid frontmatter or without a valid `trigger` (skipping a `README.md` in `rules/` without frontmatter), and warns on a `model_decision` rule without a `description`, a `glob` rule without `globs`, content cut to fit the 24 KB limit, or an `AGENTS.md` or `GEMINI.md` at the plugin root instead of in `rules/`.

Improved the inline diff preview when the agent asks to edit or create a file so it renders like the `/diff` file view, with syntax highlighting for your color scheme, background tints on added and removed lines (picked from your terminal's light or dark background when using the `Terminal` color scheme), and an untinted line-number gutter.

Improved CPU usage while typing and while the agent is working by rendering the prompt area once per frame, reusing measured line widths for unchanged rows across frames, and rendering the animated status line in styled runs instead of one character at a time.

Fixed `Enable Telemetry` in `/config` remaining editable for Business accounts (such as Google Cloud project and Application Default Credentials sign-in via `AGY_ADC_AUTH`), where prompts, content, and model responses are never collected: the row now shows `off (disabled)` and explains why, and first-run setup with `AGY_ADC_AUTH` now shows the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service without the consumer telemetry opt-in checkbox.

Fixed agent commands failing to start on Windows versions that don't support the terminal sandbox (Windows 10 and Windows 11 before version 24H2) when a sandboxed permission mode was selected: the CLI now turns off the terminal sandbox and falls back to asking before running commands, and the Remote Control browser Settings modal hides sandboxed permission options on those systems.

Fixed socket disconnect errors such as `broken pipe`, `software caused connection abort`, `network is down`, and `http2: client connection lost` (for example after laptop sleep or a Wi-Fi change) stopping the turn with `Agent execution terminated due to error.` instead of retrying automatically and reporting a network error if retries fail.

Fixed an MCP server continuing to show as `Ready` in `/mcp` after its process exited unexpectedly, which left later tool calls failing with `client is closing: EOF`; the server is now marked as `Error` and its closed session is removed.

Fixed large structured tool outputs (such as JSON results from MCP tools) bypassing the per-step token limit while still being counted as truncated, which could push long conversations past the model's context window before automatic compaction ran.
Fixed clickable links in agent responses whose URL contains `;` opening a URL cut off at the first `;` in terminals and multiplexers that split link sequences on semicolons.
Fixed `/title` and `/remote-control` rejecting `on` and `off` when typed with uppercase letters, such as `/title ON` or `/remote-control Off`.

title.zh-TW: agy plugin validate 擴充檢查範圍，把關技能、子代理與規則設定
title.en: agy plugin validate Expands Check Coverage to Guard Skills, Subagents, and Rule Configurations

body.zh-TW:
打包套件最怕設定缺漏。現在 `agy plugin validate` 會把關技能、子代理與規則。⟦跟遠行清單一樣，以前只看外觀，現在連證件效期都逐項核對，有疏失立刻示警。⟧

`SKILL.md` 缺標頭（frontmatter，檔首宣告）會報錯；缺 `name`、`description`、資料夾名不符、逾 24 KB 或同名略過則警告。

子代理標頭錯誤、缺欄位、`agent.json` 解析失敗或用保留名報錯；重複名稱、無標頭檔或被忽略的 `agent.json` 則警告。

規則標頭無效或缺 `trigger` 報錯（略過 `README.md`）；缺描述、`globs`、逾 24 KB 或根目錄誤放 `AGENTS.md`、`GEMINI.md` 則警告。
body.en:
Nothing is worse when packaging plugins than missing configuration settings. Now `agy plugin validate` guards skills, subagents, and rules. ⟦Like a travel checklist, it previously only inspected luggage exteriors, but now it verifies document expiration dates item by item and flags any oversight immediately.⟧

A missing `SKILL.md` frontmatter triggers an error. Missing `name` or `description`, folder name mismatches, exceeding 24 KB, or skipped duplicate names trigger warnings.

Subagent frontmatter errors, missing fields, `agent.json` parsing failures, or using reserved names trigger errors. Duplicate names, files without frontmatter, or ignored `agent.json` files trigger warnings.

Invalid rule frontmatter or a missing `trigger` triggers an error (skipping `README.md`). Missing descriptions, missing `globs`, exceeding 24 KB, or mistakenly placing `AGENTS.md` or `GEMINI.md` in the root directory triggers a warning.

items.original: Improved `agy plugin validate` to also check a plugin's skills, subagents, and rules: for skills, it errors on a `SKILL.md` with missing or invalid frontmatter and warns when `name` or `description` is missing, when `name` doesn't match its folder, when the body is over the 24 KB limit, or when a skill in `skills/` is skipped because an earlier skill has the same name; for subagents, it errors on an `agents/` Markdown file with invalid frontmatter or a missing `name` or `description`, an unparseable `agent.json`, or a name reserved for a built-in agent, and warns on duplicate agent names, Markdown files in `agents/` without frontmatter, and `agent.json` files, which the CLI ignores; and for rules, it errors on a rule with invalid frontmatter or without a valid `trigger` (skipping a `README.md` in `rules/` without frontmatter), and warns on a `model_decision` rule without a `description`, a `glob` rule without `globs`, content cut to fit the 24 KB limit, or an `AGENTS.md` or `GEMINI.md` at the plugin root instead of in `rules/`.

title.zh-TW: 檔案行內差異預覽對齊檢視樣式，支援語法高亮與增刪襯色
title.en: Inline File Diff Previews Align with Inspection Styling, Supporting Syntax Highlighting and Tinted Changes

body.zh-TW:
收到代理人請求編輯或建立檔案的確認提示時，你現在能在對話區直接看清每一處改動細節。行內差異預覽（inline diff preview，在對話中直接顯示檔案修改對照的畫面）現在對齊 `/diff` 檢視風格，支援當前配色方案的語法高亮。⟦如同在合約草稿上使用雙色螢光筆批註，以前確認改動只有單調的黑白純文字，現在新增與刪除的行別會以專屬襯色清晰標記，行號欄也保持乾淨不被色彩干擾。⟧

新渲染方式為新增與刪除的程式碼行加上背景襯色。若選用 `Terminal` 配色方案，介面會根據終端機的淺色或深色背景，挑選對比最適當的底色。

畫面左側的行號欄則維持無襯色，避免色塊延伸到邊欄而干擾視線，讓你審查程式碼時更容易對齊行數。
body.en:
When you receive confirmation prompts from agents requesting to edit or create files, you can now see every modification detail directly in the conversation. Inline diff previews (screens showing file modifications directly in the conversation) now align with the `/diff` inspection style and support syntax highlighting for the active color scheme. ⟦Picture annotating a contract draft with two-color highlighters: confirming changes previously relied on monotonous black-and-white plain text, but added and deleted lines are now clearly marked with dedicated tints, while the line number column stays clean and free from distracting color.⟧

The new rendering method adds background tints to added and deleted code lines. If the `Terminal` color scheme is selected, the interface selects the most suitable contrast tint based on whether the terminal background is light or dark.

The line number column on the left side of the screen remains untinted, preventing colored blocks from bleeding into the margin and distracting your gaze, making it easier to track line numbers during code reviews.

items.original: Improved the inline diff preview when the agent asks to edit or create a file so it renders like the `/diff` file view, with syntax highlighting for your color scheme, background tints on added and removed lines (picked from your terminal's light or dark background when using the `Terminal` color scheme), and an untinted line-number gutter.

title.zh-TW: 終端機渲染機制調整，降低打字與執行時的 CPU 消耗
title.en: Terminal Rendering Adjustments Reduce CPU Consumption During Typing and Execution

body.zh-TW:
頻繁在終端機輸入長篇文字或等待背景運算時，你的電腦不會再莫名感受到風扇狂轉的散熱壓力。現在提示區在每個影格只渲染一次，跨影格時也會直接重用未變更文字列的測量寬度。⟦好比翻閱逐格動畫冊，以前每翻一頁就把整面黑板全擦乾淨、逐字重新測量重寫，現在沒變動的段落直接保留，動態跑馬燈也整段套色，不再一個字一個字慢慢畫。⟧

底端的動態狀態列（status line，終端機底端提示執行進度的橫列）過去是一次渲染一個字元，現在改為依相同樣式區段批次繪製。

排版優化減少了重繪時的重複計算，使你在終端機打字或等待回覆時的 CPU 使用率顯著降低。
body.en:
When frequently typing long passages into the terminal or waiting on background computations, your computer will no longer endure spinning cooling fans from thermal strain. The prompt area now renders only once per frame and reuses measured widths of unchanged text rows across frames. ⟦Think of flipping through an animation flipbook: previously, every page turn wiped the entire chalkboard clean to remeasure and rewrite character by character, but unchanged sections are now retained directly, and dynamic banners are styled as entire spans rather than drawn slowly glyph by glyph.⟧

The dynamic status line (the bar at the bottom of the terminal displaying execution progress) previously rendered one character at a time, but now batches rendering by identically styled segments.

Layout optimizations reduce redundant computations during redraws, noticeably lowering CPU usage while typing in the terminal or waiting for responses.

items.original: Improved CPU usage while typing and while the agent is working by rendering the prompt area once per frame, reusing measured line widths for unchanged rows across frames, and rendering the animated status line in styled runs instead of one character at a time.

title.zh-TW: 企業帳號鎖定遙測為關閉，初次設定移除一般遙測勾選框
title.en: Enterprise Accounts Lock Telemetry Off, Removing Consumer Telemetry Checkbox from Initial Setup

body.zh-TW:
如果你平時使用企業帳號或 Google Cloud 專案登入工具，設定介面現在會明確反映資料隱私政策。企業帳號與透過 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 登入的環境本就絕不收集提詞、檔案內容或模型回覆，但先前在 `/config` 設定選單裡，遙測開關（telemetry，軟體回傳診斷與使用數據的機制）卻仍處於可切換狀態。⟦就像公務用車配有不可關閉的資安規格，以前面板開關還能隨意撥動讓人困惑，現在直接固定在關閉檔位並貼上說明，交車時也不再附上一般民眾的意向調查表。⟧

現在 `/config` 中的 `Enable Telemetry` 列已改為顯示 `off (disabled)`，並附帶文字說明鎖定原因。

初次執行並透過 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 初始化設定時，畫面僅會顯示 Google Cloud Platform 服務條款，直接移除一般消費者的遙測授權核取方塊。
body.en:
If you routinely log in using an enterprise account or a Google Cloud project, the settings interface now explicitly reflects data privacy policies. Enterprise accounts and environments authenticated via `AGY_ADC_AUTH` never collect prompts, file contents, or model responses in the first place, yet the telemetry toggle (a mechanism transmitting diagnostic and usage metrics) remained switchable inside the `/config` settings menu. ⟦Consider an official fleet vehicle equipped with non-toggleable security standards: previously, the dashboard switch could be toggled at will to everyone's confusion, but it is now locked in the off position with an explanation attached, and delivery no longer includes an optional consumer survey form.⟧

The `Enable Telemetry` row in `/config` now displays `off (disabled)` accompanied by text explaining the reason for the lock.

During initial launch and configuration setup via `AGY_ADC_AUTH`, the screen displays only the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service, outright removing the standard consumer telemetry consent checkbox.

items.original: Fixed `Enable Telemetry` in `/config` remaining editable for Business accounts (such as Google Cloud project and Application Default Credentials sign-in via `AGY_ADC_AUTH`), where prompts, content, and model responses are never collected: the row now shows `off (disabled)` and explains why, and first-run setup with `AGY_ADC_AUTH` now shows the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service without the consumer telemetry opt-in checkbox.

title.zh-TW: 舊版 Windows 遇沙盒限制改為執行前確認，設定面板隱藏不相容選項
title.en: Older Windows Falls Back to Pre-Execution Prompts Under Sandbox Limits, Hiding Incompatible Settings

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 10 或尚未升級至 24H2 的 Windows 11 電腦上操作時，指令執行不再因為作業系統缺少沙盒支援而動彈不得。以前若在此類系統選取了沙盒權限模式，終端機隔離防護（terminal sandbox，將指令限制在受控邊界內執行的安全環境）會因環境不支援而導致代理人指令啟動失敗。⟦與遊樂設施的安全門檢驗相似，以前遇到感測器規格不符的舊閘道會直接卡死鎖上，現在設施會自動切回人工驗票口，購票面板也不再列出無法支援的感應手環選項。⟧

現在命令列會自動關閉終端機沙盒，啟動備援措施，改為在執行各項指令前先跳出確認提示。

遠端控制（Remote Control）在瀏覽器中的設定彈窗，也會直接在此類系統上隱藏沙盒權限選項，避免誤選無效設定。
body.en:
When operating on Windows 10 or Windows 11 PCs not yet upgraded to 24H2, command execution will no longer stall because the operating system lacks sandbox support. Previously, selecting sandbox permission mode on such systems caused terminal sandboxing (a secure environment confining commands within controlled boundaries) to fail during agent command startup due to lack of environment support. ⟦Just as an amusement park ride manages safety gates, older turnstiles with incompatible sensors previously locked up completely, but the attraction now falls back to a manual ticket gate and removes unsupported wristband options from the ticket kiosk.⟧

The command line now automatically disables the terminal sandbox and activates a fallback, prompting for confirmation before executing each command instead.

The Remote Control settings popover in the browser also hides the sandbox permission option on such systems, preventing accidental selection of invalid settings.

items.original: Fixed agent commands failing to start on Windows versions that don't support the terminal sandbox (Windows 10 and Windows 11 before version 24H2) when a sandboxed permission mode was selected: the CLI now turns off the terminal sandbox and falls back to asking before running commands, and the Remote Control browser Settings modal hides sandboxed permission options on those systems.

title.zh-TW: 網路斷線改為自動重試，筆電休眠或換網不再中斷工作
title.en: Network Disconnections Trigger Automatic Retries, Keeping Work Intact Across Laptop Sleep and Network Switches

body.zh-TW:
帶著筆電在不同會議室間移動，或是闔上螢幕喚醒電腦後，交給代理人執行到一半的任務不會再輕易中斷。以往當系統碰上網路連線端點（socket，程式之間建立連線傳輸資料的介面）斷線，例如筆電休眠或切換 Wi-Fi 後觸發的 `broken pipe`、`software caused connection abort`、`network is down` 或 `http2: client connection lost`，對話會直接以錯誤訊息終止。⟦遇上長途通話訊號不穩時，以前只要路過隧道斷訊一瞬間電話就直接被掛斷，現在通話軟體會先在背景自動重新撥號嘗試接回，真的連不上才會跳出撥打失敗的警示。⟧

現在工具遇到此類斷線錯誤時，會在背景自動展開重新連線重試。

只有在重試依然無法建立連線時，代理人才會回報網路錯誤，不再因為短暫的網路波動而拋棄整輪進度。
body.en:
When moving a laptop between conference rooms or waking it after closing the lid, tasks handed off to the agent will no longer easily abort midstream. Previously, when the system encountered network socket disconnections (interfaces establishing connections to transfer data between programs)—such as `broken pipe`, `software caused connection abort`, `network is down`, or `http2: client connection lost` triggered after laptop sleep or switching Wi-Fi—the conversation terminated outright with an error. ⟦During an unstable long-distance phone call, passing through a tunnel previously dropped the line the moment the signal cut out, but calling software now redials automatically in the background to reconnect, displaying a call failure alert only when connection truly fails.⟧

When tools encounter these disconnection errors now, they automatically initiate reconnection retries in the background.

Only if retries still fail to establish a connection will the agent report a network error, no longer discarding an entire round of progress over momentary network fluctuations.

items.original: Fixed socket disconnect errors such as `broken pipe`, `software caused connection abort`, `network is down`, and `http2: client connection lost` (for example after laptop sleep or a Wi-Fi change) stopping the turn with `Agent execution terminated due to error.` instead of retrying automatically and reporting a network error if retries fail.

title.zh-TW: 修復 MCP 工具管線：當機即時標示錯誤，大筆資料不再繞過上限
title.en: Fix MCP Tool Pipeline: Immediate Crash Errors and Enforced Limits on Large Payloads

body.zh-TW:
串接服務或查詢大筆資料時，現在連線防護與記憶管理更穩固。使用 MCP 工具（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）時，過去伺服器行程意外終止，`/mcp` 仍顯示為 `Ready`，導致後續工具呼叫失敗跳出 `client is closing: EOF`；現在會標記為 `Error` 並清除已關閉的工作階段。⟦比照工廠外接儀器，跳電時控制板亮故障燈並切斷線路，不再假裝正常；傳送超長數據時也依規矩截切，不再塞爆暫存區。⟧

針對大型 JSON 等結構化資料，過去即便計為截斷，仍繞過單步計費單位（token，AI 處理與計費的文字單位）限制，導致長對話在自動壓縮前就塞爆模型視窗；現在已嚴格遵守單步上限。
body.en:
Connecting services or querying large datasets now features sturdier connection protection and memory management. When using MCP tools (Model Context Protocol, a protocol connecting AI to external tools), unexpected server process terminations previously left `/mcp` displaying `Ready`, causing subsequent tool calls to fail with `client is closing: EOF`. The interface now marks them as `Error` and cleans up closed sessions. ⟦Much as external factory instruments behave, the control board illuminates a fault indicator and disconnects the line during a power trip instead of pretending normal operation, and it truncates oversized data streams by rule instead of overflowing the buffer.⟧

For structured data such as large JSON payloads, requests previously bypassed single-step token limits (text units for AI processing and billing) even when marked as truncated, overflowing the model context window before auto-compaction could trigger. The pipeline now strictly enforces single-step limits.

items.original:
Fixed an MCP server continuing to show as `Ready` in `/mcp` after its process exited unexpectedly, which left later tool calls failing with `client is closing: EOF`; the server is now marked as `Error` and its closed session is removed.
Fixed large structured tool outputs (such as JSON results from MCP tools) bypassing the per-step token limit while still being counted as truncated, which could push long conversations past the model's context window before automatic compaction ran.

title.zh-TW: 回覆中含分號的超連結不再被截斷，點擊可開啟完整網址
title.en: Hyperlinks with Semicolons in Responses No Longer Truncate, Opening Complete URLs on Click

body.zh-TW: 點擊終端機回覆中的網頁超連結時，網址參數不再因為包含特殊符號而意外遺失。以前在部分終端機或終端多工器（terminal multiplexer，能在單一視窗切割管理多個工作階段的工具）中，若代理人提供的網址包含分號 `;`，點擊後網址常在第一個分號處被硬生生截斷，導致瀏覽器開啟無效頁面。這個問題已經修好，現在包含分號的完整網址都能正確開啟。
body.en: When clicking web hyperlinks in terminal responses, URL parameters are no longer lost to special characters. In certain terminals or terminal multiplexers (tools dividing and managing multiple sessions in a single window), URLs provided by the agent that contained a semicolon `;` were previously cut short at the first semicolon when clicked, causing browsers to open invalid pages. This issue has been fixed, and complete URLs containing semicolons now open properly.

items.original: Fixed clickable links in agent responses whose URL contains `;` opening a URL cut off at the first `;` in terminals and multiplexers that split link sequences on semicolons.

title.zh-TW: /title 與 /remote-control 支援大寫開關指令，輸入 ON 不再報錯
title.en: /title and /remote-control Support Uppercase Toggles, No Longer Erroring on ON

body.zh-TW: 隨手在終端機輸入斜線指令調整功能時，你不再需要小心翼翼確認大小寫鎖定鍵。以前使用 `/title` 設定標題，或是使用 `/remote-control` 開啟遠端控制時，若輸入了大寫的開關參數（例如輸入 `/title ON` 或 `/remote-control Off`），指令會直接判定無效並拒絕執行。這個問題已經修好，現在無論輸入大寫或小寫的開關文字，指令都能正確識別並順利切換。
body.en: When typing slash commands into the terminal to adjust settings, you no longer need to double-check Caps Lock. Previously, when using `/title` to set titles or `/remote-control` to enable remote control, entering uppercase toggle arguments (such as `/title ON` or `/remote-control Off`) caused commands to be flagged as invalid and rejected outright. This issue has been resolved, and commands now correctly recognize and toggle settings regardless of whether uppercase or lowercase text is supplied.

items.original: Fixed `/title` and `/remote-control` rejecting `on` and `off` when typed with uppercase letters, such as `/title ON` or `/remote-control Off`.

entries: Added terminal status reporting over OSC 7501: in terminals that support it, the tab or window shows whether the CLI is working, waiting for your input, done, or failed. The CLI checks for support first, so other terminals are unaffected. Set `AGY_CLI_OSC7501=off` to turn it off, `AGY_CLI_OSC7501=on` for a terminal that supports it but doesn't answer the check, or `AGY_CLI_OSC7501_MESSAGES=brief` to show only the status without details such as the pending command or question.

Added the `alt+m` shortcut (`Option+m` on macOS when Option is set to act as Alt) to send a message using the opposite of your `Queued Messages` setting in `/config`, so you can send right away while in `Queue` mode, or queue a message while in `Send Immediately` mode.

Improved `agy plugin validate` so it checks a plugin with the same rules the CLI uses to load it, instead of simplified checks that rejected valid plugins (such as a manifest without a `name`) and missed problems that kept a plugin from loading. It lists each error and warning with its file and line, accepts a plugin directory or its `plugin.json`, warns about common `plugin.json` mistakes such as unknown fields (with "did you mean" suggestions), invalid names, and components placed inside `.antigravity-plugin/` instead of the plugin root, and adds `--strict` to fail on warnings and `--json` for a machine-readable report in CI.

Fixed the CLI refusing every message with `Eligibility check failed` until you restarted it when the service was briefly unavailable or rate-limited at launch; the check now retries temporary errors and no longer locks the session.

Fixed plugin MCP servers that use a variable in a request header, such as `"Authorization": "Bearer ${TOKEN}"`, sending the literal placeholder and failing to authenticate; headers now get the value you configured, like the server's command, arguments, and environment already did.

Fixed the `/diff` Commit Tree view: the header now counts commits instead of lines, the cursor stops only on commit rows and `Enter` opens that commit, the view fills the terminal height, and it shows the latest 100 commits (previously 10) with scrolling.

Fixed the agent losing track of its file changes, tasks, and session cost when a background command finished while the agent kept working; they no longer roll back to the point where that command started.
Fixed a background command's final output sometimes missing from its task log; the output is now always recorded when the command finishes or is canceled.
Fixed links to directories disappearing from agent responses; they now show the directory name, for example `pipelines/`.
